New Jersey.focus: Workforce, essential providers, care beyond the office, prevention, chronic disease
New Jersey.description: New Jersey's Medicaid agency plans five initiative areas for its more than 1 million rural residents in eleven counties, blending directed and competitive funding.
initiatives: RHT1 Workforce
Recruitment, training and retention of clinical and non-clinical providers.
RHT2 Essential providers
Funding for CCBHCs, FQHCs and hospital emergency services.
RHT3 Regional partnerships
Care outside the office through telehealth, remote patient monitoring and mobile care.
RHT4–5 Prevention and chronic disease
Community preventive health and evidence-based chronic disease interventions with data integration.

New Mexico.focus: Healthy Horizons, Rooted in New Mexico, community-led innovation
New Mexico.description: New Mexico's Health Care Authority plans to expand access and strengthen outcomes for rural, frontier and Tribal communities.
initiatives: Healthy Horizons
Regionalized specialty and maternal care networks, provider training and remote care technologies.
Rooted in New Mexico
Rural and Tribal workforce pipelines, clinical training and retention supports including housing and mentorship.
Rural Health Innovation Fund
Competitive grants for community-designed, community-led health initiatives.

New York.focus: Community integration, tech-enhanced primary care, workforce, technology and cybersecurity
New York.description: New York plans four interrelated initiatives for its roughly 2.1 million rural residents, shaped by input from nearly 170 stakeholder organizations.
initiatives: Rural Community Health Integration
Rural health partnerships coordinating care across the continuum and addressing social needs.
Technology-Enhanced Primary Care
Improving rural access to and use of high-quality primary care.
Rural Roots
A self-sustaining cycle of rural workforce development.
Technology Innovation and Cybersecurity
Telehealth, eConsult partnerships, usable alerts and stronger cybersecurity at rural facilities.

North Carolina.focus: NC ROOTS hubs, prevention, behavioral health and a sustainable delivery system
North Carolina.description: North Carolina's program, led by NCDHHS's Office of Rural Health, aims to improve outcomes and access for nearly 3 million rural residents across 85 of 100 counties through six integrated initiatives.
initiatives: NC ROOTS Hubs
Locally governed networks connecting medical, behavioral and social services in one place.
Prevention and chronic disease
Primary care access, food as medicine, diabetes and hypertension management, cancer screening and perinatal health.
Behavioral health and SUD
Expanded behavioral health and substance use services, integrated with primary care.

North Dakota.focus: Workforce, Make North Dakota Healthy Again, care closer to home, modern tech and data
North Dakota.description: North Dakota's five-year roadmap targets workforce shortages, fragile facilities, outcome gaps for Tribal and frontier communities, and fragmented technology.
initiatives: Strengthen and Stabilize the Rural Health Workforce
New residencies, grow-your-own pipelines, recruitment and retention grants.
Make North Dakota Healthy Again
Eat Well ND and ND Moves Together for nutrition, physical activity and behavioral health.
Bring care closer to home
Telehealth, remote monitoring and care coordination.
Modern tech and data
Cross-linked data, cooperative purchasing, automated pharmacy kiosks and AI-assisted care.
